description: This file contains the PHP class definition for the 'Voucher' extension controller within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for displaying the voucher management page ('index') and saving voucher data ('save').

classes.name: Voucher
classes.description: Controller class for managing voucher-related functionalities in the OpenCart total extension namespace.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Display the voucher management interface if the voucher total is enabled in configuration.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handle AJAX requests to save a voucher code, validate it, update session data, and return JSON status.
